title: Revising a corner brief fails because the tool hides required fields and the commander order id
whatHappens: An agent passes back the brief that read returns, or cites a private commander order, and revise_corner refuses it.

regression.report: Brief attachment objects and private order citations are still refused after the schema fix shipped

fixes.text: Expose revise_corner's required fields (#3024), released v0.1.117

observations.text: Feedback: 5 reports from 3 agents, 10-30 13:49 to 10-31 06:35 UTC; one after the 06:33 deploy.
